items.evidence: python main.py --headless --ticks N [--inputs/--script] [--board 1-3] [--settings-dir D] printed one JSON object with tick, screen, board, score, lives, ball, coins, crates, bridge_x, volume, language, selected, texts, sounds (e.g. --ticks 0 gave title, volume 8, en, selected Start).
--frame on 15 runs (title, settings, play boards 1-3, paused, won, lost) each wrote a PNG whose IHDR reads 800 x 480; opened and viewed.

sounds/*.wav and `python main.py --wav NAME PATH` (byte-identical): coin 0.30 s, bounce 0.16 s, fall 0.80 s, clear 0.80 s; RMS 4616/6810/14459/9429; all four differ (different durations and zero-crossing rates 2460/206/832/1508 per s).
Opens on title with selected Start; menu_down x1/2/3 -> Settings, Quit, Start (wraps); menu_up -> Quit, Settings; '0 enter' -> screen play, board 1, score 0, lives 3.
Settings shows ['Settings','Volume: 8','Language: English','Back']; 5x menu_right -> 10 (clamped), 12x menu_left -> 0; menu_left/right on Language toggle en/es; enter on Back -> title.

With es: title ['Roll','Empezar','Ajustes','Salir'], settings ['Ajustes','Volumen: 5','Idioma: Español','Volver'], play ['Tablero 1 de 3','Puntos: 0','Vidas: 3'] (boards 2, 3 likewise), paused adds 'En pausa','Continuar','Salir al título', won 'Has ganado', lost 'Fin del juego', 'Pulsa Intro para volver al título'. Only the game name Roll is unchanged.
First run with --settings-dir set volume 5 and es; a second run with the same folder at tick 0 reported volume 5, es and Spanish texts; a run without the folder reported 8, en.
'0 enter', no input: y first <= 0.3 at play tick 27, back above 0.3 at tick 29, y = 0.25 at tick 600; sounds = 3x bounce. Same with --board 1.
Board 1, at rest, push 30 ticks then none: right x 0 -> 0.47 at push end -> 1.63 (+40 ticks) -> 3.37 (+110); left/up/down mirror exactly in -x, -z, +z.
One coin: score 10, (2,0) left coins, 'coin' added. Steered script from --board 1 took all four: board 2, score 40, sounds ...coin x4, clear; ball at (-3,1.25,0) at rest, coins of board 2, 6 crates.
--board 2, no input: crates at (0,0.25|0.75,-0.5|0|0.5); maximum deviation over 300 ticks 0.0.

--board 2, '120 right': ball reaches x=1 after 98 ticks vs 88 (kinematic, matches board-1 reference of 77 ticks for 3 m) on an empty board; middle bottom crate pushed to x 0.56 then off, top middle crate dropped to (0.29,0.25,0); no crate below y 0.2 while over the board.
Same strike: crate at (7.84,-2.59,0) at tick 300 still listed, gone (5 crates) by tick 500; the other crates stay at their places.

Board 2 after strike + coin: fall at tick 859 -> lives 2, 'fall' added, ball (-3,1.25,0) at rest, coin (1.5,0) still taken, crates identical before/after. Fall on board 1 then clearing it -> board 2 with lives 2.

Ball rolled onto bridge at tick ~720 kept x - bridge_x within 0.15 of its offset over 180 ticks (incl. a reversal), y stayed 0.25 for 500 ticks, lives 3. Pushed right at tick 120 with bridge near x=1.8: fell into gap, lives 2, 'fall'.
Script b3win.txt with --board 3 (coin over the gap taken while riding the bridge): won at tick 970, score 30, sounds coin x3 + clear; 200 further ticks with pushes changed nothing; enter -> title.
--board 2, '120 right;180 none;700 right': lost at tick 1230, lives 0, score 10; 300 more ticks with left/up/down: score, ball, coins, crates identical; enter -> title.

Escape mid-strike on board 2 -> paused, selected Resume; ball and moving crates unchanged at tick 500 despite 'right'; bridge_x frozen at 0.556 on board 3; enter/escape resumes and continues exactly as an unpaused run; menu_down+enter -> title.
Three pairs of CLI runs (board 2 strike 900 ticks incl. crates, board 3 win 1300 ticks, menu+play 700 ticks) printed byte-identical JSON.

b2_strike.png: perspective from above/front, whole board, shaded red sphere at x 0.85, crates as shaded boxes at their state places (one at 1.36, one lifted between columns), coins shown. b3_t90/t180.png: two slabs, gap, bridge at centre 1 then touching the right slab at 2.
Viewed title_es, settings_es, paused_es, won_es, lost_es: Spanish texts drawn (accents and Ñ rendered); play frames show 'BOARD n OF 3' / 'TABLERO n DE 3', score and lives.

--wav NAME PATH --volume 0 wrote all-zero samples for all four; main.py play() returns at volume 0 and passes g.volume to sound.wav_bytes, which scales by volume/10 (sound.py:47); at volume 0 state 'sounds' still lists bounce x3, coin.
README gives keys and goal, exact commands for headless run, frame and WAV (all worked as written) and a file-by-file map.

defects: Crates only translate, never rotate: the brief asks that the ball topple them; the README admits this.
A strike only moves the crate column it hits; the stacked crate drops straight down instead of tipping.
Ball vs slab sides not modelled (README admits): a ball past an edge just falls.
Menus wrap around (menu_down on Quit returns to Start); harmless but not asked for.

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger
